heading: Use of public buildings for offices by instructors
lead: Whenever practicable, instructors of the National Guard shall use State armories or other public buildings for offices.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes Revised sectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 70732:74.May 12, 1917, ch. 12 (10th proviso under “National Guard”), 40 Stat. 68. The word “instructors” is substituted for the words “inspector-instructors”, since there are no longer any “inspector-instructors”.
